title: lanium microphyllum
intro: Lanium microphyllum, commonly known as Blue Vervain, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic agent. The therapeutic actions of Blue Vervain include its use in treating anxiety, insomnia, and other nervous system disorders, as well as its potential to reduce fever and alleviate digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Lanium microphyllum include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
